narrative.title: Late crisis-timing adherence probe
narrative.summary: A minimal authored world whose only purpose is to probe condition adherence: a single crisis window is placed late in the horizon and nothing else is stressed.
narrative.lesson: Not a scenario for a user -- a WP2.2 Task 6 battery fixture exercising the crisis_timing condition type placed late.

dispatches.headline: The first years are uneventful
dispatches.detail: Only the placement is being probed here.

dispatches.headline: A shock hits late in the horizon
dispatches.detail: The crisis window opens at quarter 30.

dispatches.headline: The window closes after four quarters
dispatches.detail: The same moderate, stated severity as the early pair.
